canonical_project: Goodman Tsukuba Tech Central / Tsukuba Data Centre Campus
notes: Goodman announced infrastructure works for 1,000MW of power at a new Tsukuba City, Greater Tokyo campus; the first 50MW facility was due in 2026 under a heads of agreement. Official TYO05 page identifies Tsukuba Tech Central as Goodman's next-generation data center and technology campus in Tsukuba City.
